Money Myth:
The Free Paid-Off Home

lines.text: Paid off your house? You still pay rent. To the county.
lines.say: Paid off your house? You still pay rent. To the county.

lines.text: ATTOM: the average US single-family property tax bill was $4,427 in 2025.
lines.say: ATTOM says the average property tax bill was about forty-four hundred dollars in twenty twenty-five.
Up from about thirty-eight hundred in twenty twenty-one.

lines.text: Insurance averaged $2,872 a year in 2026 (quotes for $300K of dwelling coverage), per Insurance.com.
lines.say: Insurance averaged about twenty-nine hundred in twenty twenty-six, per Insurance dot com.

lines.text: Add a 1% upkeep rule of thumb: a $400K example home runs $3,600 in tax (0.9%), plus $2,872 insurance, plus $4,000 upkeep.
lines.say: Add a one percent upkeep rule of thumb, and a four hundred thousand dollar example home runs thirty-six hundred in tax, plus insurance, plus four thousand in upkeep.

lines.text: That's $10,472 a year, or about $873 a month.
lines.say: That's about ten thousand five hundred a year, or eight hundred seventy-three dollars a month.

lines.text: Skip the taxes long enough and the county can take it. One Minnesota county seized a condo over about $15,000 in tax debt and penalties.
lines.say: Skip the taxes long enough and the county can take it. One Minnesota county seized a condo over a fifteen-thousand-dollar debt.

lines.text: It kept the extra $25,000, until the Supreme Court ruled 9-0 in 2023 that it couldn't.
lines.say: It kept the extra twenty-five thousand, until the Supreme Court ruled nine to zero in twenty twenty-three that it couldn't.

post.title: A paid-off $400K house can still cost $873 a month
post.ig:
Paid off your house? You still pay rent. To the county.
ATTOM: the average US single-family property tax bill was $4,427 in 2025, up from $3,785 in 2021.
Insurance.com put the average 2026 homeowners premium at $2,872 a year (for $300K dwelling coverage); a common upkeep rule of thumb is about 1% of value a year.
Example $400K home: $3,600 tax + $2,872 insurance + $4,000 upkeep = $10,472 a year, about $873 a month.
Unpaid property taxes can lead to tax foreclosure, as in Tyler v. Hennepin County (2023).
Sources: ATTOM 2025 property tax report; Insurance.com 2026; US Supreme Court, Tyler v. Hennepin County (2023).
News and education, not financial advice.
